summary: Posts support co-authors and a featured flag that prefers curated stories on the homepage and channel listings.
detailed_changes: Added post_author pivot while keeping primary author_id; public articles and author archives list co-authors.
Added posts.featured boolean with staff toggle; homepage and channels prefer featured then latest.
Ghost content import attaches all posts_authors and imports Ghost featured.
affected_areas: Page or route: /, /{channel}, /articles/{slug}, /authors/{id}, staff post editor
User groups affected: staff editors; public readers of bylines and curated home
Public impact: co-author bylines; featured stories can lead home/channel
Internal impact: staff can curate featured posts and assign co-authors
